GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 486.8 (14 Jan 46) CE
(SCAPIN - 597)
14 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hydrographic Department Drawings and Reproduction Materials.
1. It is directed that the Japanese Government submit to this headquarters all geodetic records and computations, boat survey sheets, compilation smooth sheets, final and color separation drawings, photographic negatives, and printing plates now held by the Japanese Hydrographic Department for all areas outside the Japanese Main Islands. At the discretion of the Chief Engineer, this headquarter, certain exceptions may be made in the submission of small-scale materials, which will remain in the custody of the Japanese Government.
2. The materials to be submitted will be delivered not later than 1 March, 1946, to a place designated by the Chief Engineer, this headquarters, together with inventory lists covering all items.
3. The requirement for photographic copies of compilation smooth sheets contained in memorandum to Imperial Japanese Government thru Central Liaison Office, Tokyo, dated 14 December, AG 400 (14 Dec 45)CE, subj : "Reproduction of Smooth Sheets", remains in effect only for the Japanese Main Islands.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
